name: Ceviche curing
summary: Raw fish stays in lime juice with salt and chilli for a few minutes, until the surface turns firm and opaque, and is served at once with its juice.
how: Cut very fresh fish into cubes of 2 cm and chill it to 4 °C.
Add salt, chilli and the juice of fresh limes in the same bowl.
Leave the fish in the acid for 2 to 4 minutes, no more.
Serve at once in a cold bowl with the juice and a sweet or crisp side.

origin.note: The first firm records of the lime cure of fish are of the early nineteenth century in Lima.

adoptions.via: Gastón Acurio served ceviche as a fine-dining course at Astrid y Gastón in Lima.
